Is it right for Muslim woman to run a beauty parlour 7221 views Q. Tooth Cap 4174 views Q. I have a question regarding taxi cabs in Chicago. Is it allowable to tranport drunk passengers? Let me explain you the situation here: During morning shifts(5Am to 5PM) the passengers are mostly those going to office, airport or shopping malls. But during evening shifts, customers are mostly going to Bars/Pubs/strip clubs. There are certain streets which have bars one after the other. Going on those streets means you are going near bars. Also cabbies line up outside famous bars/pubs. If you want to avoid these customers you have to take small streets where you are almost certain of not getting any customers. Then to pick up customers you have to go to office areas which will be very far. After 11PM there is hardly anyone else on the streets other than drunk revelers. Another issue you can consider is that if anyone is trying to flag you down, you cannot refuse them. But that is just a rule and can be conveniently broken. In short avoiding bar areas is feasible but you make 1/3rd of what other people make. 2137 views

Question: assalamualikum , i'm zarjoon khan,currently working in travel agency in riyadh ksa. i need a fatwa for insurance & etc. generally insurance is haram in islam.airlines required tax from passenger for insurance which is call insurance tax. it must have to pay to airlines while buy a air ticket my question is this insurance tax permissible? is it relative of riba. my duty is selling a air ticket am i involve whether if it's haram?also few airlines providing alcohol during fly & showing cinema inside the flight im selling a ticket for airlines. sure those are sin. me afraid that am i involve such sin.can i work this field(travel agency) please give me a fatwa for me & deeply explain. hope you will assist me regarding this matter . jazakhallahu khairah! Answer ID: 15879 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1462/1183/L=1430) As per the Shariah, it is impermissible to pay insurance tax while purchasing air ticket, but it is compulsory for buying a ticket; therefore in compulsion it is regarded lawful. You only sell the ticket, there is nothing forbidden involved in your work, you are not responsible for what the airline does like offering wine and showing film; therefore you can work in the travel agency. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
